body:
Refreshed with main (6a10c5ad); the merge itself had no textual conflict. #945 is already in main. Main's recorded-stream guards (#926) arrived with the merge, and this slice's dump writes `PARAM WorkOffset 1.000000` where they had `G54`. So I applied #1113's rule: I regenerated **only** the eight stream files with WRITE_GOLDEN=1 (post `recorded_streams`, app `recorded_post_streams`). Every script golden and posted golden is byte-identical. PROCESS_VERSION is 25, the same as main; this PR doesn't change it. Head 558e61e5.

Tests: every camcraft-post suite passes: `work_offset_index` 9, `recorded_streams` 10, all eleven `script_*` suites 9 each, `post_engine` 33, plus the rest. App `sinumerik_work_offsets` 2/2 and `recorded_post_streams` 2/2. Clippy on post and app with `-D warnings` is clean. Mergeable.
Quick pass (M5): body complete, gate reported green on this head, no open requested change; flagged ready for review. Conflicts with main (if any) are refreshed at merge time (PROCESS_VERSION 31).
Back to draft (M5): my quick pass readied this by mistake. It's held for the user's PathPilot Hub run, and there's no hands-on result yet. It goes ready again once that run is recorded.

Merge-time refresh attempted, nothing pushed. The text conflicts in assets/posts/carvera.cps (manifest: both sides added lines, workOffsetIndex/workOffsetMax and coolantModes) and assets/posts/AGENTS.md (manifest paragraph: serves from main, workOffset text from this PR) are mechanical and keep both sides. But the merged tree fails the targeted gate for a logic reason: main added recorded streams crates/post/tests/recorded/streams/css_then_live.cnc and live_then_stop.cnc, which still carry 'PARAM WorkOffset G54', while this PR's generator now writes 'PARAM WorkOffset 1.000000' (recorded_streams: css_then_live_stream_is_current and live_then_stop_stream_is_current are stale). Also main added assets/posts/grblhal.cps and tinyg.cps, which do not set workOffsetIndex (they take the legacy G54..G59 word path; the decision file and assets/posts/AGENTS.md say every shipped post sets it, and work_offset_index.rs does not list them). The author should merge main, update those two goldens with the PR's other streams and re-read the script goldens they feed, and decide on the two new posts.

Merged main to resolve conflicts (merge commit 487bd088c), refresh at merge time; PR stays a draft.

Kept both sides: the `workOffsetIndex` / `workOffsetMax` manifest lines beside main's `programUnits` / `millSpindleReverse` / `coolantModes` lines in carvera, doosan-dnm, fanuc-lathe, fanuc, haas, heidenhain, mazak, sinumerik, tormach-lathe, tormach-plasma, tormach .cps; `assets/posts/AGENTS.md` (main's manifest text with the two work-offset keys added and the engine-read count made "last eight"); `post/mod.rs` (`pub mod units;` and `pub mod work_offset;`); `post/engine.rs` (main's `units::refusal` block stays first, then the PR's `work_offset::Manifest::read`).

Re-recorded 30 recorded stream files that main added or changed after the branch point (commit 72e0b8b6e; 28 `recorded/inputs/` probe and inverted_probe files plus `streams/css_then_live.cnc` and `streams/live_then_stop.cnc`), still saying `PARAM WorkOffset G54`. The only changed lines are 33 `PARAM WorkOffset G54` lines becoming `PARAM WorkOffset 1.000000`; nothing else in any file, no posted-output golden, no snapshot PNG. Tests: camcraft-post `recorded_streams` (`css_then_live_stream_is_current`, `live_then_stop_stream_is_current`) and camcraft-app `recorded_post_streams::every_recorded_probe_stream_is_current`.

Gate: `cargo test -p camcraft-post` all green; app `recorded_post_streams`, `posting`, `conformance`, `post_unit_word`, `program_units`, `sinumerik_work_offsets` green; `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean.

Open point for the review: `assets/posts/grblhal.cps` and `tinyg.cps` (new on main) do not set `workOffsetIndex` and run through the legacy word path, while the PR text and `assets/posts/AGENTS.md` say every shipped post sets it.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 72e0b8b6ee787e3c96e6d5bce9fdbd0c67aa8fdf -->
**Verdict: Needs a small change before merge (one doc line); code, refresh and tests are clean. Held for the author's PathPilot Hub run.**

Full review at the high tier (changes what the posts read for the work offset), head 72e0b8b6e, trial-checked as it stands (PR is MERGEABLE with main, no trial-merge needed).

**What looks good**
- No second derivation of G54-G59: the app still hands the word and `setup::wcs_slot` is untouched. In the post crate `work_offset::Manifest::translate` is the only place a number becomes a word: unflagged scripts get `G54`..`G59` for 1-6 only (`legacy_word`), flagged scripts get the number and write their own word.
- Refusal, not wrong output: an index above the script's `workOffsetMax`, a non-index value (`G53`, 0, 2.5, `G54.1 P3`) and an unflagged script above 6 are all refused by setup name (`work_offset.rs` translate, `engine.rs:153-170`). The engine records them as warnings and skips the param; `posting.rs:549` and `posting_mounts.rs:248` turn any warning into "post blocked", so nothing is posted at a default G54. (Note for later callers of `run_program_with`: the refusal is a warning, not an `Err`, so a caller that ignores `warnings` would see G54. The app does not.)
- Refresh merge 487bd088c, read with `--remerge-diff`: 14 both-sides-added conflicts (11 post manifests, `assets/posts/AGENTS.md`, `post/mod.rs`, `engine.rs`) resolved by keeping both sides, nothing else. In `engine.rs` main's `units::refusal` block runs first (line 113-116) and the `work_offset::Manifest::read` follows it. Manifest lines from main (`programUnits`, `millSpindleReverse`, `coolantModes`) are all still present.
- Commit 72e0b8b6e verified: 30 files, 33 insertions and 33 deletions, and the only changed lines are `-PARAM WorkOffset G54` / `+PARAM WorkOffset 1.000000` (counted with `sort | uniq -c`, nothing else). They are 28 files under `recorded/inputs/` plus `streams/css_then_live.cnc` and `streams/live_then_stop.cnc`. Across the whole PR diff against main no file under `tests/golden/`, `recorded/goldens` or `crates/ui/tests/snapshots` changed; the only recorded files that moved are `PARAM WorkOffset` input streams.
- No build.rs, `.github/`, scripts, Cargo.toml or dependency change. `assets/posts/AGENTS.md` is not a process file, so no `PROCESS_VERSION` bump is owed (main is 52). Provenance line, decision file `docs/decisions/931-wcs-index-post.md`, `Changelog:` line and `Refs #931` (no closing keyword) are all in place. `work_offset.rs` is 154 lines; `engine.rs` and `js.rs` were over 400 before and grew by 20 and 6.

**Local results (this head, own worktree target)**

| Run | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-post` (45 result lines, every binary) | all passed, 0 failed |
| app `recorded_post_streams` | 5 passed |
| app `posting` | 17 passed |
| app `conformance` | 7 passed |
| app `sinumerik_work_offsets` | 2 passed |
| app `program_units` | 7 passed |
| app `post_unit_word` | 5 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
1. `assets/posts/AGENTS.md` (the manifest paragraph, "Every shipped post sets it") and `docs/decisions/931-wcs-index-post.md` ("all shipped scripts" / the PR text "All 11 shipped scripts") are no longer true: `grblhal.cps` and `tinyg.cps` (new on main) do not set `workOffsetIndex`. Fix the wording ("every shipped post except grblhal and tinyg, which still take the word"), or set the flag in both; if you set it, add them to the script list in `work_offset_index.rs`.

**Open point, my call: a follow-up, not a blocker.** `grblhal.cps:302` and `tinyg.cps:298` read `PARAM WorkOffset` as the word and put it straight into the header (`wcsWord`). With the engine in this PR they run on the unflagged path: offsets 1-6 get exactly `G54`..`G59` as before, and an offset 7 or higher is refused by setup name before the script runs ("...does not declare workOffsetIndex, so it can only post offsets 1-6"), which the app turns into "post blocked". So neither post can emit a wrong or dropped word for an offset beyond G59; the gap is only that they cannot gain more offsets (grblHAL and TinyG have G54-G59 only in the public docs I know of, so 6 is likely their true maximum anyway). Please file a `P7` follow-up "grblhal/tinyg: declare workOffsetIndex and workOffsetMax" (or set the flag in this PR) - not needed for safety.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Hold stated by the author: the PR body says "This changes the post interface ... so it waits on a Hub run before it is flagged ready", and the comment "Back to draft (M5): my quick pass readied this by mistake. It's held for the user's PathPilot Hub run, and there's no hands-on result yet. It goes ready again once that run is recorded." That check is still owed; this review did not replace it.
- Slices 2 and 3 (#1113, #1124) stack on this; the `Dump` field still carries the word until slice 2.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Review item 1 addressed at `e188b4f6` (docs only): `assets/posts/AGENTS.md` now says every shipped post sets `workOffsetIndex` **except grblhal.cps and tinyg.cps**, which still take the word (offsets 1-6, above that refused by setup name). The PR body says the same. The open point is filed as a P7 follow-up, #1385. The decision file had no 'all shipped' claim to change. Still a draft: the author's PathPilot Hub hold (G59.1-G59.3 on the Tormach post) stands until the user runs it.

PathPilot Hub run done: **pass**. This is the run #1101 was held for; it covers the stack #1101 → #1113 → #1124.

- **Program:** posted from #1124's head (d97157c2, which contains #1101 and #1113), with the Tormach PathPilot post on the Tormach 770MX, inch: one program with five setups at **G54, G59, G59.1, G59.2 and G59.3** (index 1, 6, 7, 8, 9), each a 1 in square 2D contour with T31.
- **Sim:** PathPilot v2.14.4, 770MX SIM. The work offsets were set with `G10 L2 P6..P9 X[#5221+2/4/6/8] Y#5222 Z#5223` (copying G54, stepping X by 2 in).
- **Result:**
  - PathPilot loaded the program with **no unknown-word error** for G59.1, G59.2 or G59.3.
  - Before the offsets were set it warned "Work offset G59.x is all zeros (effectively G53)", which confirms it parses all three as work offsets.
  - The status line showed **G59.1** and then **G59.3** active as each setup ran.
  - All five squares cut, 2 in apart, with no alarm, ending at `M30`; cycle time 00:03:01.
- **Headless checks:** the G54 and G59 programs are byte-identical to upstream main's for the same project. Offset 10 is refused by name ("expresses work offsets 1-9 only") and no program is written.

The feeds and speeds in the test (S2500, F20) came from the test project, not from these PRs.
taken by SKULL for the refresh @ e188b4f6

Hub record for SKULL (taking over this stack): the user ran the G59.x Hub check on 2026-11-13 11:33-11:37 - `hub-tests/1101-770MX-wcs-index/wcs_all_5_setups.nc` (posted from #1124 @ d97157c2) on the 770MX sim, offsets set by G10 L2 P6-P9: no unknown-word error, G59.1 and G59.3 shown active, five squares cut 2 in apart, M30, 3:01 - **PASS**. A re-run is needed only if the posted WCS words change from d97157c2.

Merge-time refresh: `upstream/main` (2d15a617) merged into the branch. New head **3460d7ba** (plain merge commit, no rebase, no force).

Per-file resolutions (all kept both sides; no logic changed differently on both sides):
- `assets/posts/fanuc-lathe.cps`: manifest - this PR's `workOffsetIndex` / `workOffsetMax` lines kept beside main's Explain G-code block (`explainWords`, `explainTool`, #1399).
- `assets/posts/mazak.cps`: state block - this PR's `var wcsIndex = 1;` kept, with main's reworded `sRpm` comment ("S.. M3 waits"); main's `millSpindleReverse` / `spinRev` lines auto-merged beside `offsetWord(value)`.
- `crates/post/src/post/mod.rs`: module list - main's `pub mod rotary_cap;` and this PR's `pub mod work_offset;` both kept.
- `crates/post/src/post/engine.rs`: `run_program_with` - this PR's `work_offset::Manifest::read(&mut s)` kept, followed by main's Explain form refusal (#1386). Both read the loaded script; neither depends on the other.
- `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`, snapshot PNGs, `CHANGELOG.md`, `RECOMMENDED.md`: main's (this PR touches none of them).

Output check: the PR's diff against main after the refresh is line-for-line identical to e188b4f6's diff against its old base (scripts, crates, docs compared hunk by hunk), so the Hub-tested output stands: G54 and G59 unchanged, G59.1-G59.3 as tested, offset 10 still refused by name (`work_offset_index::every_shipped_script_posts_offsets_up_to_its_max_and_refuses_one_past` passes).

Gate on 3460d7ba:
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: green - post suites (70 s) + 93 app suites (260 s), 1093 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

NeoTech: the doc fix for your review is at e188b4f6, and this refresh is at 3460d7ba. Please re-review; the needs-rework label is yours to clear.
